Echo State Networks (ESNs) are a type of recurrent neural network used for processing time-series data. They consist of a large, fixed-size reservoir of randomly connected nodes, which acts as a nonlinear dynamical system. The weights of the output layer are trained to map the reservoir's responses to the desired output. Reservoir computing is a computational paradigm that leverages the inherent dynamics of a reservoir to process information.
